# Environmental Factors Influencing the Land-Ocean Contrast in Lightning and Overshooting Tops over Northern Australia

Code accompanying the paper: *"Environmental factors influencing the land-ocean contrast
in lightning and overshooting tops over northern Australia"* (citation to be added on
publication).

## Overview

This repository processes and analyzes overshooting-top (OT) and lightning detection
data over northern/tropical Australia (2016-2024), classifies detections by land/ocean
surface type and lightning-OT co-occurrence, and examines the environmental (convective)
and atmospheric onditions associated with each category using BARRA-R2 reanalysis data.

## Data availability

Raw data files are not included in this repository due to size and institutional access
restrictions. See paper for the more details:

- Overshooting-top detections: calculated using Himawari-8/9 satellite using algorithm.
- Lightning detections: Commercial provider DTN, obtained via Bureau of Meteorology, Melbourne.
- Reanalysis: BARRA-R2 (via NCI)
